sourceText:
Easy Chili
By: Melissa Peterman
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




Kitchen
5 pounds Ground beef, lean
5 lrg Onion, chopped
40 ounces Tomato puree, can
15 ounces Tomato paste, can
30 ounces Kidney beans, rinsed & drain
2 1/2 quarts Water, or more
10 tablespoons Chili powder
2 1/2 Garlic, to taste
Oregano

Preparation

1 SAUTE THE ONION in a non-stick pan, or in a little butter until tender. If you want the chili hot, saute with the chili powder. When the onions are limp, add the beef, and brown, breaking up with a spoon. (Drain if you like). Add puree, paste, chili powder if you didn't brown it, beans, and 16 oz. water. And salt & pepper if you like it. Cover and simmer over low heat for 2 hrs., stirring occasionally. 2 Add more water if it gets too thick. Good served over mashed potatoes. You may need more water, depending on the cooking temperature. And you can adjust the amount of chili powder to taste. And you can add spices of your choice. This is an easy dish for camping.
